results.contents:
About Genius AI

Genius AI is building technology to help local businesses run themselves. Genius AI products do the admin work that keeps practitioners from the work they love and the people they serve. From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

Genius AI technology has saved businesses 106M in admin hours, earned them $2.0B in additional revenue, and facilitated more than 624M client touch points.

About the Role

Genius AI is building 0-to-1 AI products we expect to be a massive revenue driver, and this role sits at the center of that build. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll be the technical anchor for our highest-innovation teams: setting architectural direction, validating options through proof-of-concepts, and turning ambitious initiatives into clear, buildable roadmaps. This is an IC role with real leadership weight, roughly 60% architecture, planning, and technical direction, 40% hands-on building. The person in this role will be a force multiplier: unblocking engineers before they know they're stuck, making the hardest technical calls so the team doesn't lose momentum, and setting a new standard for what great backend engineering looks like at Genius AI. You won't be maintaining systems someone else designed, you'll be raising the ceiling on what this team can build, and doing it in a way that makes everyone around you better in the process.

This role is remote in the Greater Toronto Area.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and own the technical direction of AI-powered products and 0-to-1 builds, weighing long-term trade-offs with precision and keeping a healthy backlog of forward-looking, build-ready work
  • Integrate AI models and LLMs into customer-facing products, not as experiments, but as production systems with real reliability and performance requirements
  • Shape how Genius AI builds with AI, your architectural decisions will define what's possible across the product for years
  • Write high-quality code and rapidly ship proof-of-concepts to validate architectural options and tackle the team's hardest technical challenges before they become blockers
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business goals into well-architected initiatives with clear sequencing and minimal rework
  • Proactively identify and resolve systemic technical debt before it slows the team down, unblock engineers, raise the quality bar, and make the people around you disproportionately more effective

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a strong backend focus, and a track record of owning system design and architectural choices for high-scale or high-growth products
  • Already building with AI as a structural part of how you work, you've integrated LLMs into production systems, used AI tooling to accelerate your development workflow, and have a sharp point of view on where AI changes what's architecturally possible
  • Ship fast and course-correct, you're comfortable making architectural calls with incomplete information, iterating rapidly in production, and treating ambiguity as a feature of early-stage work, not a reason to slow down
  • Deep Kotlin expertise with strong intuitions about backend architecture, service design, and performance at scale (TypeScript experience is a plus)
  • Solid command of modern cloud infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes, at the level of someone who can navigate it confidently without being a pure infra specialist
  • Natural collaborator who can align PMs, designers, and engineering teams around a shared technical vision and keep execution moving without friction
  • Exceptional communicator who can make complex architectural trade-offs legible to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

Benefits & Perks 

  • Competitive health & dental insurance options
  • Flexible PTO
  • Annual stipend for professional development and continued learning
  • High performers at 5 years receive a $5,000 bonus to use however you recharge best
  • Paid parental leave
  • Fertility and adoption benefits via Carrot
  • Local events - in-person gathering opportunities throughout the year for our distributed team
At GlossGenius, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. We believe this benefits not only our employees but our product, customers, and community as well. GlossGenius is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.

Personal Information: Notice at Collection for Employees and Applicants

Agency Submissions
If a resume or applicant is submitted to Genius AI by a third party without a signed search agreement in place, it will become the property of Genius AI and no fee will be paid, irrespective of whether the candidate is hired. 

Genius AI may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence and machine learning systems (AI Tools), to assist in evaluating applicants’ qualifications and fitness for the position. These AI Tools may be used alongside human review during one or more stages of the recruiting process, including application screening, skills assessments, and interviewing. No final hiring decision will be made solely by AI Tools without human oversight.

What the Candidate Will Do

Agency Partnership & Account Leadership

  • Establish the Gold Standard: Position Uber Advertising as an indispensable, strategic partner to Canada's priority agency holding companies.
  • Navigate the Ecosystem: Build and nurture deep-rooted relationships across the agency spectrum-from investment and strategy to programmatic, data, and C-suite leadership.
  • Architect Joint Business Plans (JBPs): In lockstep with Global and US&C leads, co-author the blueprints for agency success and long-term commitment.
  • Global-to-Local Bridge: Serve as the high-speed link between global strategy and flawless local market execution.

Commercial Ownership & Growth
  • Own the Outcome: Drive relentless in-quarter revenue performance while constructing the scaffolding for multi-year, scalable partnerships.
  • Scale at Pace: Identify and industrialize joint commercial opportunities across diverse agency client portfolios.
  • Revenue Accountability: Partner with Sales to own pipeline development, precise forecasting, and aggressive growth targets.
  • Operational Excellence: Build the frameworks and incentive programs that turn \"potential\" into high-velocity platform adoption.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Matrix Mastery: Rally Sales, Product, Marketing, and Ops teams to deliver a cohesive, \"One Uber\" agency experience.
  • Shape the Narrative: Influence the GTM strategy and sales enablement tools that define how the Canadian market views Uber Advertising.
  • Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the Canadian marketplace, providing high-signal feedback to inform our global product roadmap.

Basic Qualifications
  • 10+ Years of Hustle: Extensive experience in media, advertising, or platform partnerships, specifically navigating the complexities of global agency holding companies.
  • Proven Scale: A track record of managing and scaling multi-million dollar advertising businesses.
  • Agency Fluency: Deep, existing networks within major agency holding companies and a \"native\" understanding of their operating models.
  • Commercial DNA: Strong business acumen with a bias toward revenue-generating outcomes.
  • Matrix-Ready: Experience thriving within a complex, fast-moving, cross-functional organization.
  • Cultural Alignment: You don't just know Uber's values-you embody them every day.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Speed & Resourcefulness: You thrive in ambiguity and move faster than the speed of the industry.
  • Master Storyteller: The ability to weave data into compelling narratives that influence decision-makers and close deals.
  • Data & Measurement Pro: Experience with 1P data solutions and a comprehensive understanding of the full-funnel measurement stack (Lift vs. Attribution).
  • The \"Go-Getter\" Spirit: A proactive approach to problem-solving; you don't wait for a map, you draw one.
  • Inclusive Leadership: You are an advocate for progress and diversity, committed to advancing the industry and building trust through respect.
  • People Catalyst: A passion for motivating others and leading by example to win as a team.

For Canada-based roles: Uber may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process; however, Uber employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions. This advertisement relates to a current, existing vacancy.

~~ ~~

For Canada-based roles: The total on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is CAD $225,000 - CAD $250,000. The OTE includes a base salary range of CAD $135,000 per year - CAD $150,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of CAD $90,000 - CAD $100,000.

You may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

results.contents:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most-played PC game in the world, millions of players log in every month. Players form the foundation of our community, and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That’s where you come in.

As a QA Engineer (Contract) for an unpublished R&D product, you will work with numerous disciplines to ensure quality bars are met across the software development life cycle. You will work with your team of artists and producers to create value for players around the world. It will be important for you to protect the player experience and deliver results in a high pressure, agile development environment. You will also be tasked to work with other QA professionals, often remotely to get your work completed.

Responsibilities:

Impact/Scope

    • Your execution of quality activities (testing, risk assessment) impacts the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of your team and closely related teams.
    • You have specific recommendations for improvements on the development process and quality of the products you work on.

Complexity

    • You solve complex problems by innovating on best practices, and implement new ways of approaching  and mitigating quality risks. 

Supervision/Oversight

    • You need little instruction on day-to-day work, and you are able to operate independently, while also instructing junior QA and external testers in their day to day tasks. 

Craft Knowledge

    • Your skills show expertise in one area, and you are able to deploy a variety of craft elements to solve increasingly complex problems.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years Software Quality Assurance Experience, with success leading testing efforts on a team.
  • Experience designing and executing test plans.
  • Experience managing components of a defect database.
  • Experience tasking remote testers and providing feedback on effectiveness.
  • Experience working embedded with developers and content creators.
  • Experience creating custom reports on test coverage and defect data.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Comfortable with deep-dive investigations and testing technical implementations
  • Development experience across multiple platforms (i.e. Mobile, Console, PC)
  • QA experience working on content development and integration pipelines
  • Experience with Unreal Engine 4/5 and Perforce
  • Preferred Licenses/certifications:
    • ISTQB Foundation Level
    • ISTQB Agile Tester or ICAgile Agile Testing (ICP-TST)

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!
results.name: QA Engineer II - Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

We are looking for a highly skilled and innovative Quant Developer / Strategist to join the Quantitative Strategies & Data Group within Global Markets. The team develops Python-based solutions on the Bank's strategic platform, Quartz, delivering strategic and regulatory programmes, including FRTB IMA, VaR, Strategic Risk and PnL, etc.. The role offers exposure across all asset classes (Rates / Commodity / Credit / FX / Equity) and involves close collaboration with Front Office Technology, Risk, and Quant teams. This is a hands-on role combining quantitative modelling, data analysis and engineering.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance market models (e.g. VaR) to ensure accurate measurement of risk exposures across trading books, in line with regulatory and internal governance requirements
  • Support the implementation of robust risk data testing frameworks to assess the appropriateness, completeness and reasonableness of risk scenarios, VaR, expected shortfall and stress test calculations. This includes testing scenario design, implementation, results consolidation, and analyses of calculations to understand key drivers
  • Investigate data issues and model anomalies, expanding and debugging the existing risk and PnL calculation code, and improving performance and maintainability
  • Partner with Tech, Quants and Risk partners to ensure that the solutions are scalable and aligned with the programmes' needs
  • Drive continuous improvement through critical review of model development and validation outcomes, and constructive challenge and feedback on technical documentation

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Masters/PhD level in a quantitative subject (Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or other analytical background)
  • Proficient in Python, SQL, C++ and other
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Risk knowledge is desirable but not strictly necessary, provided there is a willingness to learn
  • We welcome applications from junior candidates with at least 2 years of financial markets experience, as well as from more experienced professionals
results.name: Quant Developer - Quantitative Strategies & Data Group
